title: Writing Task 1 - Mixed Graph: Population Growth
description: IELTS Writing Task 1: Describe a mixed graph showing population growth and urbanisation trends.

stimuli.title: Task 1: World Population Growth and Urban Population Share
stimuli.content:
You should spend about 20 minutes on this task.

The graph below combines a bar chart showing total world population (in billions) and a line graph showing the percentage living in urban areas, from 1950 to 2020.

Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

Write at least 150 words.

Data: Total population (bn): 2.5 (1950), 3.0 (1960), 3.7 (1970), 4.4 (1980), 5.3 (1990), 6.1 (2000), 6.9 (2010), 7.8 (2020). Urban %: 30% (1950), 34% (1960), 37% (1970), 40% (1980), 43% (1990), 47% (2000), 52% (2010), 56% (2020).

questionGroups.instruction: Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

questions.content: Describe the mixed graph showing world population growth and urbanisation trends from 1950 to 2020.

keyFeatures: World population more than tripled from 2.5 to 7.8 billion over the 70-year period
The urban share crossed the 50% threshold between 2000 and 2010
Both indicators showed consistent upward trends with no reversals
The rate of population growth appears to have slowed slightly in later decades
